context: Anthropic-native transport plus Claude Code surface exposure for OpenCode Go, and the first real consumer of the catalog-owning backend kind declared in G2.
root_causes: ocgo's normalizeAnthropicRequestForUpstream strips seven fields on the stated grounds that the endpoint is stricter than Anthropic's, with no per-field evidence.

The Anthropic surface's native-versus-translated dispatch is a class-level isinstance check, so an adapter implementing the native facet must serve every model including the one that refuses the Anthropic format.
Discovery aliases are minted from _MODEL_INDEX, which maps a contested id to its incumbent, so the three contested ids would never receive an opencode alias and would be unreachable in the picker.
cross_check_anthropic_models asserts every indexed Anthropic model exists in litellm_config.yaml, which a discovered catalog does not.
evidence: Measured 2026-08-22: thinking, reasoning, reasoning_effort, effort, level and depth all returned 200 on glm-5, kimi-k3 and minimax-m3; only output_config returned 400 invalid_request_error.
output_config scoped across all 22 /messages-capable ids: 9 reject (kimi-k3, three minimax, five qwen), 11 accept, 2 inconclusive.
system was accepted in both string and list-of-blocks form, the latter being what Claude Code sends, so no normalization is required.
The families rejecting output_config are largely those ocgo marked as requiring /messages, suggesting its table conflated special handling with endpoint choice.
kimi-k3 returns a proper thinking content block while glm-5 leaks raw </think> markers into text content.
cross_check_anthropic_models already exempts _CODEX_MODELS and _KIMI_MODELS from config existence as seeded data, while still enforcing backend membership.
solutions: Strip only output_config, unconditionally, and name the six kept fields explicitly so the decision reads as measured rather than missed.

Implement the AnthropicNativeAdapter facet so /messages is dispatched directly, and fall back to the chat-completions transport via the repo's own translators for the one model that refuses the format.
Use X-API-Key on the native path, since Bearer returns AuthError there.
Declare the catalog in _CATALOG_OWNING_BACKENDS and mint discovery aliases from that declared catalog rather than from the index.
Extend the drift guard's seeded-data exemption to catalog-owning catalogs, scoped to config existence only.
Move the launcher catalog row to G6, which already owns uninstall and restore artifact ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Every stripped field has a test tied to an observed upstream rejection; no strip is speculative.
The six fields ocgo strips speculatively survive normalization, thinking budget included.
system survives untouched in both string and block form.
Normalization never mutates the caller's payload.
The adapter serves the Anthropic-native facet and dispatches /messages with X-API-Key.
A model refusing the native format is still served on the surface via the translated path.
All 29 catalog ids have discovery aliases, generated from the catalog rather than a curated tuple.
A qualified id reaches OpenCode even when the bare id belongs to an incumbent, and fails closed outside the catalog.
No pre-existing bare id changed backend.
The drift guard still enforces backend membership for every seeded id.
legacy_risk_reason: adds a backend to SURFACE_BACKENDS and seeds a 29-id catalog into the shared routing index, so a regression can silently move an existing bare id to a different upstream subscription
